svg.title: PACF-guided autoregressive lag selection evidence
svg.desc: A four-panel generated chart of fictional daily inspection requests. It shows the ordered training, validation, and final test periods; a training-only PACF with strong spikes at lags 1 and 7; validation MAE selecting AR lags 1 and 7; and final test forecasts where the selected model has MAE 3.23 requests versus 5.26 for the same-weekday baseline.
